bio: Scott Winston Colom ( kə-LOHM; born December 24, 1982) is an American lawyer and politician serving since 2016 as district attorney for the 16th Judicial District of Mississippi. He is the Democratic nominee in the 2026 United States Senate election in Mississippi. Though the race has not been called, he holds a narrow lead and is likely to win.

items.t: As district attorney, worked to exonerate Eddie Lee Howard, who spent 23 years on death row on discredited bite mark evidence (2021).
items.q: Through Colom's efforts, Eddie Lee Howard, who spent 23 years on death row for a murder conviction based on discredited bite mark evidence, was exonerated in 2021.

items.t: Signed a letter with other district attorneys condemning the criminalization of gender-affirming surgery.
items.q: he had signed onto a letter with other district attorneys condemning the criminalization of gender-affirming surgery.

items.t: Was nominated by President Biden in 2022 for a U.S. District Court judgeship in the Northern District of Mississippi.
items.q: On October 14, 2022, President Joe Biden announced his intent to nominate Colom to serve as a United States district judge of the United States District Court for the Northern District of Mississippi.
